chapter: Brass bands and Louis in New Orleans
title: Zulu parades and brass band players
summary: Punch played Zulu parades for seven or eight years; he and the interviewers sort out the brass band lineup including a snare drummer, trombonist Frank Dusen and tuba player Willie Cornish.
